emma_csm: Heads-up — Catalyst renewal on 2026-07-01. They want to shorten to 9 months and add 10 seats. Need pricing, PO routing, and enablement plan.
ryan_sales: thanks emma. current commit = 30 seats. proposed total = 40. do they want billing split by region?
emma_csm: single billing entity but procurement asked for vendor code and net30. they also want seats active on renewal date.
carla_fin: vendor code VF-3030, net30 ok. if single billing entity we'll issue one invoice. need PO to match vendor code.
nate_legal: short-term (<12mo) discounts require amendment. i'll prepare a 9mo amendment with refund language. any special compliance for this account?
ella_enable: if seats go live day 1 we need one 60-min kickoff + two 30-min follow-ups. can deliver within week of sign.
docusign-bot: Delivery queued to catalyst-signers@catalyst.com — please verify signer list.
emma_csm: quick pro-rate calc (for new seats only):
pro_rate = seats_added * monthly_price * 9
example = 10 * $150 * 9 = $13,500
apply_discount = pro_rate * 0.06 (recommended 6% for 9mo)
net = pro_rate - apply_discount
ryan_sales: sounds good. action items:
- emma: confirm signer emails and send PO template to customer (today)
- nate: draft amendment (48h)
- carla: prepare invoice template and attach PO example (48h)
- ella: reserve enablement slots pending sign
carla_fin: attached sample invoice in email thread. will switch to net30 terms on final.
emma_csm: target sign date 2026-06-20 to keep onboarding on 07/06. i'll update customer. :thumbsup:
